$comment: Tool names from the Catalyst MCP tool listing (180 tools). Never executed by c2c; doctor D-B5/D-B6 checks presence and records schemas. Names are compared without any host prefix. byFeature holds only tools a provisioning step or a shipped plugin skill actually calls; a listed tool with no call site is dropped, never demanded.

neverCall.List_All_Projects: returns project secrets (jwtSecret, clientSecret) into the transcript; c2c lists projects through the Catalyst CLI (name and id only)
neverCall.Get_Project_By_Id: returns project secrets (jwtSecret, clientSecret) into the transcript; c2c reads the project through the Catalyst CLI (name and id only)

probeFirst.List_All_Emails_Configuration: the plan's sender read-back tool; present in the recorded schemas (plugin/references/mcp-schemas/)
probeFirst.Create_Upload_Signature: object upload route not exercised by c2c
